body: Charles T. Lauber (CFO to Q2-2026) on 2025-07-24 (Q2-2025 earnings call transcript (Motley Fool)): "We continue to expect to realize annual savings of approximately $15 million from our 2024 restructuring actions" Metric: annualised restructuring savings (company). Target: ~$15 mn in 2025. Deadline: 2025-12-31. Specificity: precise; volunteered. Status as of 2026-11-22: delivered. Evidence: Q4-2025 call: 'The restructuring actions we took in late 2024 and expense management drove profitability improvement of 130 basis points despite lower sales' (China); RoW earnings flat despite -4% sales. The $15 mn itself is not separately reported.
